capabilities: open .stp and .step files as interactive 3D views
rotate, pan, and zoom models with mouse controls
switch between solid shading, wireframe, and edge overlay
snap to ISO, front, right, and top preset views
render at 1:1 scale with a scale bar and XYZ axes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Supports STEP AP203 / AP214 only; installation is manual via release download.
problem: Obsidian cannot display 3D CAD files, so .stp and .step files in a vault have no usable preview.
summary: CAD file viewer that opens STEP (.stp/.step) models as interactive 3D views with orbit controls, display modes, and preset views.
